summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Sony Music HipHop x BeatsByDez store. 14/14 backend tests passed (products, artists, orders, newsletter). E2E frontend flow verified: home, shop filters, product detail with size/qty, add-to-cart, cart persistence across reload, full checkout to /api/orders, order success page, artist page, newsletter signup with toast. No critical issues found.

issues: Radix DialogContent console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for {DialogContent}.' — non-breaking a11y warning; add SheetDescription / DialogDescription or aria-describedby to silence.

action_items: (Minor a11y) Add a Description / aria-describedby to the Cart Sheet (CartSheet.jsx) and the Product image lightbox dialog to remove Radix console warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); migrate to lifespan handler in a future iteration (non-blocking).
Order number is generated from uuid4()[:8] without collision check — fine for an MVP demo; for production add a unique index on orders.order_number to fail-fast on rare collisions.
Seed runs delete_many({}) on every startup — by design per problem statement, but it wipes any user-modified data; OK for current scope.
Email field in Order/Newsletter accepts plain str — consider Pydantic EmailStr for stricter validation.
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds 1 artist (DEZ) + 8 products on every startup. Tests created TEST_ prefixed orders and newsletter signups in Mongo (not cleaned up; acceptable for MVP).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_dez_store.py — reuse as regression. All 8 products have artist='DEZ'. Free shipping >=$100 else $9.99. Order number pattern: SM-XXXXXXXX (11 chars total). Checkout form data-testids: checkout-name, checkout-email, checkout-address, checkout-city, checkout-zip, checkout-country. Cart sheet uses slug-based testids: cart-item-{slug}, cart-increase-{slug}, cart-decrease-{slug}, cart-remove-{slug}. localStorage cart key: sm_hh_cart_v1. Producer page at /artists/dez (no list page).
rca of the issue: No bugs found — MVP works end-to-end.
